notes: Proof-of-principle dark photon dark matter search using a one-electron quantum cyclotron in a Penning trap at 148 GHz (m_A' = 0.612276 meV). Null result over 7.4 days gives epsilon < 3.2e-11 at 90% CL, ~75x better than previous XENON1T/cosmology bounds. The limit applies only in a very narrow band (~100-200 kHz around 148.048 GHz, i.e., delta-m ~ 1e-9 eV), so it is effectively a single mass point.
